race.comment: Race of the day to finish if the top two both run. VEYEPEE (15) looked good in his maiden campaign and resumed with a huge victory at Sandown Hillside, settling a long way back off a fast speed and powering home to score by 1.5 lengths. He's capable of settling much closer (he's led in the past) and gets in on the minimum with Blake Shinn on. MR VERSE (10) has been thereabouts in three runs this time in and has each-way claims. CASTLE ON HIGH (13) chased home Changing Colours last time which is good form. He should be running on, while VICTORIOUS SPIRIT (14) also has to be included second up with Nolen taking over.
